project.name: Proven
project.summary: A pull-request reviewer whose every finding carries evidence a reader can check again: a test that fails on the change, or a query through Zetaris and the rows it returned.

track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

builders.name: Marcin "Wato" Marzec
builders.role: owner: decides and merges; writes no code

zetaris.use_case_note: Proven's REST adapter reaches our local Zetaris and the live-service check proves it answers; in the review scenario today the same SQL still runs over local sample tables, and live Zetaris evidence in a review is being wired in.
zetaris.how: The evidence layer: the Investigator proves a finding about a dependency with one SQL query over REST and the rows it returned (CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS, OSV by advisory id). In sample mode the same SQL runs over local sample tables shaped like the Zetaris views; live Zetaris evidence in a review is next.

meterless.use_case_note: H-MEM and the World Model run in every review, sample mode included; the live model calls through Nightshift work, while the sample scenario uses recorded answers.
meterless.how: H-MEM remembers findings refuted in earlier reviews, so they do not come back; the World Model holds the entities a review has seen, and its ingest survives a kill and a restart. Both are a minimum in Go, checked with Meterless's own conformance suites (World Model 8 of 8; H-MEM 9 of 13, its failures the sections not built yet). All four engines are on by default, in Proven and in the lab, and each has its own off setting (`PROVEN_HMEM`, `PROVEN_WORLD_MODEL`, `PROVEN_MARKOVIAN`, `scout_intent`); the benefit of Markovian (bounded steps for a large change) and Scout Intent (the plan of a review) is UNMEASURED until the corpus recordings exist (ADR-0053). Every model call goes through Meterless Nightshift, and the answering model is read from its signed receipt.

cursor.use_case_note: Cursor is how Proven is built: every product change of day one was coded by a Cursor agent.
cursor.how: Cursor agents write Proven's product code: up to four at once, headless on a Linux machine, each from a signed order, in its own copy of the repository, inside a jail with its own network and an egress door, and with every model request recorded by a proxy. 17 changes were merged on day one.

nvidia.use_case_note: Nemotron answers through Nightshift with signed receipts, and both guardrail backends are built; in the sample scenario a recorded guardrail answers, and the live guardrail in a review is being wired in and tested.
nvidia.how: Nemotron answers Proven's agents through Meterless Nightshift, and the Skeptic that tries to refute each finding defaults to Nemotron; an answer that did not come from an NVIDIA model is refused by name. Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety checks every prompt and every answer, on our own model server or through NVIDIA's hosted API.

pre_existing.name: Saphan Studio
pre_existing.what: The platform that runs the agent fleet building Proven: orders, runs, reviews and their record. A tool used to build, not part of the product.
